title: Mirage
summary: This episode starts Song of Desert, a side story about Hai Bodong in the Tager Desert. Hai Bodong, the Ice Emperor and a Dou Huang, has been hired to bring back a snakewoman who has lost her memory. A masked Snakemen warrior traps him in a mirage and fights him, and he answers with Mysterious Ice Dragon's Soar. He brings the snakewoman to a desert town and hands her over to his employer, but the employer is found dead, so Hai Bodong takes his storage ring as payment and tells her she is free. She begs to stay with him. Queen Medusa then arrives at the town herself, her guards clear it, and her people say the man they hired to catch a traitor is dead.
events: The snakewoman, who remembers nothing, travels with Hai Bodong and asks his name.
A masked Snakemen warrior traps Hai Bodong in a mirage; he fights back with Mysterious Ice Dragon's Soar.
In a mercenary town, Hai Bodong brings the snakewoman to his employer per the contract (money to the Mite'er family).
The employer is dead; Hai Bodong takes his storage ring and tells the snakewoman she is free.
She begs to go with him as his servant; he refuses.
Queen Medusa arrives, her guards clear the town, and her people say the man they hired to catch the traitor died within a day.
introduced: snakewoman with no memory (later named Die)
cultivation: Hai Bodong is a Dou Huang ('Just because you're a Dou Huang', 451).

cast.name: Hai Bodong
cast.quote: Just because you're a Dou Huang, it doesn't mean I can't kill you
